def: The act of stripping, or making bare or naked.
The expressed juice of apples. It is used as a beverage, formaking vinegar, and for other purposes.
A wood of small growth; a thicket of brushwood. See Coppice.Near yonder copse where once the garden smiled. Goldsmith.

To stand in opposition; to exhibit difference, unlikeness, oropposition of qualities.The joints which divide the sandstone contrast finely with thedivisional planes which separate the basalt into pillars. Lyell.
The quality of being cursory; superficial performance; as,cursoriness of view.
Relating to, or consisting of, euchlorine; as, euchloric .Davy.

A contract or obligation under seal; a contract by deed; awriting, under seal, given as security for a debt particularlyspecified. Chitty. Bouvier. Wharton (Law Dict.).Let specialties be therefore drawn between us. Shak.
One who procrastinates, or defers the performance of anything.
Pertaining to, or derived from, heptyl or heptane; as, heptylicalcohol. Cf. .
Freeing from a burden or obligation; tending to exonerate.
